description: Works out Amazon's fees on one unit at a price: the referral fee for the category (official, with the $0.30 minimum where the category has one), the $1.80 media closing fee (official), and for FBA an estimate of the fulfillment fee from Amazon's 2026 rate cards by size tier and weight, with the 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge, and the peak-season fee from October 15 to January 14. It fits a seller who asks what Amazon takes on a sale, what FBA costs for an item, whether a price sits just over a fee line, or whether FBA or shipping it themselves costs less. Takes the price, category, fba or fbm, and for FBA the packed size and weight bands (or the packed dimensions); for FBM, the shipping the buyer pays. Or takes both (with packed, labelCost and, optionally, packaging, minutesPerOrder with hourlyValue, unitsPerMonth, inboundSplit and freightToAmazon) and compares Amazon shipping it with the seller shipping it for the same item, outside peak and from October 15 to December 31: each side's costs and what's left per unit, storage from the packed size, monthly totals, and the label + packaging + time where the answer flips. Assumes the Professional selling plan (the Individual plan adds $0.99 an item). Returns each fee, the total outside and in peak, what's left, and the price lines where a fee steps; a line whose reading Amazon doesn't confirm is marked verified: false. The FBA figure is estimate: true; Amazon's Fee Preview shows a seller's real fee. Dated rates with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

category.description: The Amazon category, which sets the referral fee, or not-sure (Everything Else, 15%, flagged).

freightToAmazon.description: both: the seller's own freight per unit to send stock to Amazon, US dollars. Left out: not counted (said).

fulfillment.description: fba (Amazon ships; adds the FBA fee estimate), fbm (the seller ships), or both (the two side by side for the same item: send packed and labelCost).

hourlyValue.description: both: what an hour of the seller's time is worth, US dollars. Send with minutesPerOrder.

inboundSplit.description: both: how stock goes to Amazon: minimal (one location; Amazon charges a placement fee), partial (2–3 locations, offered only for bulky sizes; a standard-size unit is priced as minimal), or optimized (Amazon's split, no placement fee). Extra-large pays none. Left out: placement isn't counted (said).

labelCost.description: both (required): what the seller's shipping label costs per order, US dollars.

minutesPerOrder.description: both: minutes the seller spends packing and shipping one order. Send with hourlyValue. Left out: the seller's time isn't counted (said).

packaging.description: both: packaging per order, US dollars. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged.

packed.description: The packed size and weight, as Amazon measures it: makes the FBA estimate exact to the rate card (with dimensional weight). Required with both: it can change which side leaves more, and gives the storage (cubic feet).

weightOz.description: Weight, ounces, packed (16 oz is 1 lb).

price.description: The selling price on Amazon, US dollars.

shippingCharged.description: FBM or both: what the buyer pays for shipping when the seller ships, US dollars (0 if free). The referral fee is charged on price + shipping. Default 0.

sizeBand.description: FBA only (both needs packed): small-flat (fits 15 × 12 × 0.75 in), standard-box (up to 18 × 14 × 8 in) or bigger. Send with weightBand, or send packed.

unitsPerMonth.description: both: units sold a month; adds monthly totals.

weightBand.description: FBA only (both needs packed): the packed weight band (the top of the band is used; over-3lb has no top, so it is billed from 3 lb and heavier items cost more: send packed for a closer number). Send with sizeBand.

name: sellerprofit_amazon_fees

afterFees.description: Price + shipping − fees outside peak: what's left per unit before landed cost, ads, storage and (FBM) the label.

afterFeesInPeak.description: The same in peak season (FBA's peak fee); equal to afterFees for FBM.

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

compare.description: fulfillment both only: Amazon shipping it and the seller shipping it, side by side. The top-level fees are the FBA side's.

fbmReferral.description: The referral fee when the seller ships: its working and what it's charged on (price + shipping).

notes.description: What the comparison leaves out or assumes, whatever was sent.

difference.description: How much more per unit, US dollars (0 when the same).

label.description: The same line for the label alone, at the packaging and time counted; null when no label cost gets there.

labelPackagingTime.description: FBA fee + storage + placement + freight + shipping charged − (FBM referral − FBA referral): the seller shipping it leaves more while label + packaging + time stay under this, per unit.

fbaFee.description: All-in, with the 3.5% surcharge and, in peak, the peak fee. Estimate.

left.description: Price − total: what's left per unit before landed cost and ads. Negative: it falls short by that much.

placement.description: Per unit for the inboundSplit sent. Estimate; 0 when not counted.

storage.description: One month per unit: cubic feet × the season's monthly rate. Estimate; 0 when not counted.

left.description: Price + shipping charged − total, before landed cost and ads. Negative: it falls short by that much.

leavesMore.description: Which side leaves more per unit.

monthly.description: Each side's left × unitsPerMonth, and the difference; null without unitsPerMonth.

window.description: When this side by side applies, in words.

given.description: False: the typical $1 was used, flagged.

difference.description: How much more per unit, US dollars (0 when the same).

label.description: The same line for the label alone, at the packaging and time counted; null when no label cost gets there.

labelPackagingTime.description: FBA fee + storage + placement + freight + shipping charged − (FBM referral − FBA referral): the seller shipping it leaves more while label + packaging + time stay under this, per unit.

fbaFee.description: All-in, with the 3.5% surcharge and, in peak, the peak fee. Estimate.

left.description: Price − total: what's left per unit before landed cost and ads. Negative: it falls short by that much.

placement.description: Per unit for the inboundSplit sent. Estimate; 0 when not counted.

storage.description: One month per unit: cubic feet × the season's monthly rate. Estimate; 0 when not counted.

left.description: Price + shipping charged − total, before landed cost and ads. Negative: it falls short by that much.

leavesMore.description: Which side leaves more per unit.

monthly.description: Each side's left × unitsPerMonth, and the difference; null without unitsPerMonth.

window.description: When this side by side applies, in words.

minimalSplit.description: What a minimal split (one location) costs per unit, for reference. Estimate.

counted.description: False without the packed size (cubic feet).

monthsAssumed.description: Each unit is assumed to wait about a month at Amazon.

ratePerCuFt.description: Monthly, per cubic foot: January–September and October–December rates. Estimates.

cardFee.description: The rate card's non-peak fee, before the surcharge, US dollars.

dimensionalWeightOz.description: Packed size only: when the box's dimensional weight (L × W × H in ÷ 139 × 16, in oz) is more than its packed weight and Amazon bills on it, that weight (equal to billedWeightOz); null otherwise.

exactness.description: The rates are Amazon's own 2026 cards; the fee is still an estimate, since Amazon measures the unit itself.

fee.description: All-in FBA fee per unit outside peak, US dollars: card × 1.035, rounded to the cent, plus overmax.

fromBands.description: True when built from the size and weight bands (top of the band; over-3lb is billed from 3 lb, a floor) rather than a packed size.

overmax.description: Overmax handling per unit, US dollars: extra-large up to 150 lb over 96 in long or 130 in length + girth pays $17, $21 or $25 by weight; 0 otherwise. Included in fee and peakFee.

peakAdd.description: What the holiday peak adds to the card for this size and weight row, before the surcharge, US dollars.

peakFee.description: All-in FBA fee per unit in peak season: (card + peakAdd) × 1.035, plus overmax.

surcharge.description: The 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge on it, US dollars.

fba.description: FBA only. An estimate from Amazon's 2026 rate cards for the size given: Amazon measures the unit itself; Fee Preview shows the real fee.

fulfillment.description: With both, the top-level fees are the FBA side's and compare holds the two sides.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

plan.description: The fees assume the Professional selling plan.

individualPerItem.description: What the Individual plan adds for each item sold, US dollars (official).

priceLines.description: Prices where a fee steps: referral steps in this category and, for FBA, the $10 and $50 price bands of the fee card.

estimate.description: True when the fee is an estimate: it depends on the size and weight Amazon measures.

feeAbove.description: The fee one cent above the line, US dollars.

feeAtOrBelow.description: The fee (referral, or FBA all-in) at that price, US dollars.

price.description: The highest price on the lower side of the line, US dollars.

verified.description: False: how the line applies isn't confirmed on a public Amazon page.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which figures are estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest depend on the size and stock Amazon measures). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

chargedOn.description: Price (FBA) or price + shipping (FBM), US dollars.

fee.description: Referral fee per unit, US dollars.

minimumApplied.description: True when the $0.30 minimum set the fee.

otherReading.description: Stepped categories: the fee if the lower rate applied to the slice of the price under the line (the other reading). Null otherwise.

rate.description: The rate at this price. For a category that charges each rate on its own slice of the price, above its line: the top slice's rate (working shows the slices).

verified.description: False when the fee rests on a reading Amazon doesn't spell out (stepped categories: the whole-price reading).

working.description: How the fee is worked out, in words a person can redo: "15.0% × $29.99", or "15% on the first $100.00 + 8% on the other $400.00".

totalFees.description: Referral + closing + FBA, per unit, US dollars.
